raised: The first company group has no company name, so the reader can't tell whose tracks they are
Returns are so close that the page doesn't help choose a company
Unclear which tab (לפי חברה / לפי מוצר) is selected
The '123 מקור / מחושב / הזנתה' legend is confusing ('הזנתה' unclear)
The orange 'not updated since September' warning is worrying, and its date conflicts with the footer date 03.11.2026
Unclear what 'קיבוץ לפי' would change
Investment-type chip names are confusing (עוקב מדדים - גמיש, s&p 500, קיימות, עוקב מדדי אג"ח vs אג"ח סחיר)
The big table is very long (about 13 screens)
The איילון group / new tracks with 'חדש', 'עוד לא דווח' and 'פחות מ־3 שנים' are useless for comparing
Tracks with assets of '0 מיליון ₪' are off-putting
The teal/yellow rings don't make sense beyond the two numbers
'קופה' numbers mean nothing to the reader
'מניות 101%' doesn't make sense (over 100%)
What מט"ח exposure means for the money is unclear
Unclear which fee is actually paid: מההפקדה or מהחיסכון
Dotted underlines under almost every number are unexplained
'עוד לא דווח' is unexplained (not reported by whom, and why?)
Unclear why the page won't sort by return but will sort by fees
No return after fees and tax
No tax rules for withdrawal or special options after 60
No worst-year figure per track
No last-year return
No fee in shekels
No info on how to open, withdraw or move between companies
No info on whether the fee can be negotiated
Chips for other products are unnecessary and would be dropped
The 'מההפקדה' fee line is nearly always 0% and would be dropped

problems.why: The reader only says they glanced at the assets column and preferred billions; nowhere do they say the head fails to explain that it is the money pooled in the track rather than the fund's own assets.
